# verifier/sigcat_spot_values.txt -- spot-check graphs of the ten certificates of Theorem sigmacat (part (m) of
# verify_all.sh) and the exact value of slack - b at each, as computed by the independent reviews of these
# certificates with their pure-Python definitional evaluators (s7_pycheck.py for J4, K5lt, K5_4minus, review R7_SIG7;
# s8_pycheck.py for the other seven, review R7_SIG8, its second spot-check set). slack(H) = f(H) - sum_k c_{Q_k}(H),
# b = the certificate's bound. Per certificate, in this order: the six lowest distinct values of the review's raw scan
# (their smallest labelled masks; the first attains b), the producer's argmin graph, two random relabellings of the
# first graph, five random admissible graphs, and three support graphs of an extremal construction where the review
# computed its law (J4: iterated Fano-plane complement; K5lt: C_n; K5_4minus: Sidorenko's doubling; C5: BCL's G_it;
# K5eq, K5_3minus: C_n with an iterated S_6 blow-up; K6_3: BCL's G6; K6_4minus: a three-part pattern construction;
# none for K6_4 and K7_4); repeated graphs are listed once (for example the producer's argmin when it is the first
# graph, and its relabellings when it is the empty or the complete graph).
# Columns: certificate (directory under certificates/sigma_catalogue/), colex mask on [7], slack - b (exact).
# The values are used by the steps sigcat_pyvals_* (fast) and, through s7_cmp.py, sigcat_cmp_* (--raw sigcat_*).
